purpose: Retrospective manuscript strengthening; locally fixed before these supplementary outcome runs, not a prospective registration.
unchanged: 225 paired tasks and all 450 responses including truncations
all 12 conditions and 20 main traffic seeds
calibration models, mixture coefficients, output budgets, achieved objective, fees, shared scheduler
original Service, Prompt, Calibrated, CARROT and RouteLLM results

controls.mean: Use [q-E(Q|x)]_+ from the exact calibrated mixture, sharing the forest, serving score, and measured prediction latency with Calibrated.
controls.radio: Add [sum_u B_u/C_u + mean_bits_sm/C_user - (wait_m+mu_sm)]_+ to the unchanged score. B is visible undelivered bits; C is observed, possibly delayed capacity; mean_bits is from calibration.
controls.no_tuning: No new coefficients or selection of bandwidth/load/scenario based on outcomes.
controls.cost: Prediction delay and fees retained. Controller/scheduler CPU omitted for all methods as in the original comparison; report new controller wall time diagnostically.

bootstrap.unit: Complete task identity, paired route outcomes and predictor outputs; 75 tasks sampled with replacement separately within each of three services.
bootstrap.coupling: One resampled bank per replicate is shared across both fixed traffic paths, all 12 conditions, and all methods; rerun queues and wireless delivery.
bootstrap.conditional: Calibration, predictors, two traffic/channel/target paths, and their recorded per-request overheads remain fixed. This is task-composition sensitivity, not independent tasks, retraining uncertainty, or a population-generalization guarantee.
bootstrap.report: Primary and equally averaged 12-condition cost differences; unadjusted descriptive 2.5/97.5 percentiles. Publish every replicate, including unfavorable outcomes.
